label: early original-phase input (steps 1-3) of k/t/o/2/r/p/j/3
explanation: Fires almost exclusively during the original (input) phase (99.3% of activation mass), concentrated at steps 1-3 (97% of mass; peak at t=2, rate 28%); it is nearly silent at t=0, t>=5, the delimiter, and the whole copy phase. Within that window it is driven by the current input token: k (29% rate) is strongest, then t, o, 2, r, p, j, 3; letters like y, f, h rarely trigger it. First occurrences of a token fire much more than repeats. Magnitude is modulated by the preceding context: the top activations are k or t at step 2 after j/3/k prefixes (e.g. j j k, 3 j t), and prev_tok in {j,k,3} raises firing. The step-1..3 window plus the token set captures about 80% of activation mass but only ~55% precision; many of these token/position combinations stay silent depending on the earlier tokens, which this predicate does not capture.
